title: Rotating the development screen removes selection on fixed cases
hypothesis: Drawing each generation's ten screening cases from a predeclared rotation of the development manifest, instead of always cases 0-9, raises promotion-set success because candidates stop being selected on ten fixed placements.

prediction.against: the same config with the fixed screen (logs/baseline_gpt61_sol_high)
prediction.rationale: the promotion set is untouched by rotation, so any gain there is generalisation not fit

falsified_by: promotion success no higher than the fixed-screen run, or a rotation schedule that overlaps the promotion slice (refused by check_manifest_isolation)
